    Profile

    The daughter of the leader of the Superbia Belt region, Helene is a peculiar existence who sees the world only in terms of black and white. She places little faith in the values of the insolent and speaks harshly to those around her. She is especially strict with her younger stepbrother. However, behind her mannerisms lies a hidden kindness that few ever realize.

    Origin: Superbia Belt Region
    Gender: Female
    Height: 159cm
    Weight: 47kg
    Birthday: Feb 11
    Blood Type: Type Qe
    Zodiac: Moon of the Wind Goddess
    Likes: Family
    Hobbies: Spending Time in Nature
    Illust: みかんあめ（G-ROW）
    CV: 首藤志奈
